import re
pairs=[]
for x in rows:
 msg=x.get('message',{})
 if msg.get('role')!='user': continue
 text=''.join(part.get('text','') for part in msg.get('content',[]) if isinstance(part,dict))
 if 'Demo pair' not in text: continue
 def grid_block(label):
  m=re.search(rf'{label} \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?=\nDemo pair|\nSame instance|\nWrong attempts)',text,re.S)
  if not m: raise ValueError(label)
  h,w=map(int,m.group(1,2)); a=[[int(v) for v in ln.split()] for ln in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()]
  assert len(a)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in a),(h,w,len(a),set(map(len,a)))
  return a
 inp=grid_block('Demo pair \d+ input'); expected=grid_block('Demo pair \d+ output')
 pairs.append((inp,expected))
print(len(pairs),[ (len(a),len(a[0]),new.transform(a)==b) for a,b in pairs])
